description: Approved exceptions for the dependency security release gate (scripts/dependency-audit-gate.mjs). Each entry suppresses exactly one advisory id for one package (or '*') and one scope (production|development|all). Every entry MUST document reachability, compensating controls, an approver, and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired or malformed entries fail the gate instead of silently passing.

exceptions.compensatingControls: Only trusted repository-owned lint configuration and paths; reject externally supplied glob patterns. Next.js production dependency upgraded to 16.3.8 and production audit remains mandatory. Re-evaluate by 2026-10-10.
exceptions.approvedBy: Owner explicit approval in 2026-10-03 conversation (development scope only, expires 2026-10-10)
